    Return True if a and b differ at exactly one bit position.

import re
from typing import List

def find_long_words(text: str, min_len: int = 4) -> List[str]:
    """
    Return all words in *text* that are at least *min_len* characters long.
    Words may contain internal apostrophes (e.g., "don't") which are treated
    as part of the word.
    """
    # First character must be a word character (letter/digit/underscore),
    # subsequent characters may be word characters or apostrophes.
    pattern = rf"\b\w[\w']{{{min_len - 1},}}\b"
    return re.findall(pattern, text, flags=re.UNICODE)

# Example usage:

    print(find_long_words(sample))

        result = []
        for item in data_list:

            if needed[k]:

        return result
